evr.name: THRM_MGR_EVR_OPEN_LOOP_HTR_ON_TIME_EXCEEDED
evr.description: EVR issued when a thermal zone is in open loop mode and the computed open loop duty cycle is over 100%. This can happen if the measured bus voltage is lower than the reference bus voltage to the extent that FSW's compensation (increasing the heater time on) would exceed the maximum time allowed (240s).
